research_program: Christopher Daniel Pang, PAL. Derivations with Hearthline.

upstream_argument.description: Levent Alpöge and Claude, 20 November 2026 release

reading_editions.result: An actual strict order-17 class at auxiliary conductor 64 is excluded from conductor 128 onward for every primitive odd label in a genuine Case II host family. The pure dyadic sufficient exponent improves by one and its uniform improvement is sharp.
reading_editions.originating_question_or_method: Christopher Daniel Pang asked for an independent test on the same arithmetic input. Hearthline fixed prime 17, twist 8 and the conductor-8 inner character and varied the auxiliary conductor.
reading_editions.proof_inputs_and_release_role: Alpöge and Claude supply the vanishing conditions and the actual host cutoff. Hearthline derived the signed half-sum, the shorter pure-dyadic bound and the two-row test at 17. The class number formula, class field theory and Stickelberger annihilation are classical inputs. PARI/GP certifies the independent class-group calculation.
